title: MOTIF 297 — Walls With a Point of View

shots.picture: Black frame. A Signal Rust hairline draws out from the centre (tips glowing), widens and graphic-matches into the GT3 RS taillight as the car lights up around it. Slow macro orbit, focus falls off across the body.
shots.transition_out: Light transition: the taillight glow blooms to warm white (exposure ramp + bloom).
shots.sound: Sub swell + glass line tone that follows the draw; first hit on frame 18; dark Dm drone; air swell into the white.

shots.picture: White resolves into the melting clock. Camera tilts down the ink drip; focus plane runs along the drip, the type falls soft. Tag: ART.
shots.transition_out: Motion-matched tilt: accelerates down (motion blur) into the next shot.
shots.sound: Pulse enters at 100 BPM, clock ticks on 8ths (tick/tock); downward whoosh; ink 'plip' on the cut.

shots.picture: Downward move lands on the brush-lettering ink drips. Tag: AUTOMOTIVE.
shots.sound: Brush swish; whoosh L->R on the whip.

shots.picture: Whip lands on the CR letterforms; the figure below is thrown out of focus. Tag: SPORT.
shots.transition_out: Graphic match cut, type to type, on the beat.
shots.sound: Low landing thud; paper flick on the cut.

shots.picture: Slow track across the editorial title type. Tag: CINEMA. Camera rolls into a spin.
shots.transition_out: Spin (roll) transition, continued in the next shot.

shots.picture: The spin resolves on the wheel; push through the hub.
shots.sound: Metallic shimmer (inharmonic partials); rising whoosh + air thump.

shots.picture: Push lands on the rear three-quarter and its reflection.
Warm Paper. An A4 outline draws itself; rust dimension lines extend while counters roll to 210 and 297 mm. 'A4 ADHESIVE ART POSTERS'. The A4 frame becomes a window onto the wall.
shots.transition_out: Masking transition + zoom-through the A4 window.
shots.sound: Pen scratch; mechanical counter clicks (decelerating); deep whoosh. Music cuts at the window.

shots.picture: A blank wall in window light. 'A BLANK WALL / SAYS NOTHING.' Camera begins to push in.
shots.sound: Strategic silence: room tone and a single clock ticking in the space.

shots.picture: The GT3 RS poster arrives top-edge first and is pressed flat (shadow tightens to contact). 'SAY SOMETHING.'
shots.sound: Paper flutter; top-edge tap; PRESS on the beat (music returns); smoothing swipe.

shots.picture: Pull back as six more posters land on the beat (accelerating), forming a 2-3-2 gallery wall; window light drifts across.
shots.transition_out: Hard cut on the musical hit after a 6-frame silence.
shots.sound: Each poster: flutter + press; 16th ostinato, strings crescendo, riser, accelerating ticks, reverse cymbal, 0.2 s gap.

shots.picture: HERO: perspective dolly along the finished wall, shallow focus, sun moving. A dark foreground pillar passes the lens.
shots.sound: Reveal hit: sub boom + Fmaj9 stab; deep L->R whoosh into the wipe.

shots.picture: Obsidian. A4 outline draws; rust 297 mm dimension line; MOTIF / 297 rises letter by letter; 'WALLS WITH A POINT OF VIEW' + the rust full stop. Slow ambient push.
shots.sound: Line tone (callback to the hook); logo hit + Dm(add9) bells; final single clock tick on the full stop; music resolves.

on_screen_text.text: Tag: ART (placeholder theme — replace with real collection name)
MOTIF / 297 (typographic wordmark — placeholder until the official logo file is supplied)
WALLS WITH A POINT OF VIEW.

project: Procedural project: src/film.py (picture), src/audio.py (score + SFX), src/engine.py. Re-render with `python3 src/film.py && python3 src/audio.py && python3 src/package.py`.
